assessment.summary: This study reports the successful laboratory colonization of Anopheles melas from Mbine Coly, Senegal. The researchers performed WHO tube bioassays on F2-F9 generations to assess susceptibility to pyrethroids, organophosphates, and carbamates, and conducted synergist tests with PBO. No insecticide-resistance marker genotyping was performed on the study population.
